name: Graben-Neudorf (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided white over blue, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Graben-Neudorf (a white cross with hoe and rake on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Graben-Neudorf; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Graben-Neudorf arms — cross with tools on blue
